title: Verbs
description: What an activity is, in one shared word. Games label activities however they like; the verb is what another game reads.
fallback: A receiver that does not know a verb walks its broader chain (cook → eat) until it reaches one it knows. With no broader verb it treats the activity as unclassified and shows the sender's label.
